tour.pickBusinessTypeSubtitle: This opens a real, throwaway copy of Sarang set up for that business — nothing you do here affects your actual data.
tour.revisitSubtitle: Take a guided tour anytime — stuck on a feature, or just want a refresher.
tour.genericExploreScreen: This is where you manage {{label}}. Take a look around — nothing you do here is saved.

universal.dashboardBody: This is your home screen — today's sales, trends, and quick alerts at a glance, plus a spotlight card built specifically for your kind of business, every time you open Sarang.
universal.sidebarBody: Everything Sarang can do lives in this sidebar. It only shows what's relevant to your business — you won't see features you don't need.
universal.searchBody: Press Ctrl+K anytime, from anywhere, to jump straight to any screen or action by typing its name.
universal.billingBody: Let's create one, start to finish. Add a customer, add a product, and submit — you'll see it appear immediately, exactly like a real sale. Try the grid icon next to the product search box too — it switches to Browse Products, a category-organized tile grid so you can click products straight into the cart without typing anything. Once the invoice is created, try the Print button (58mm/80mm thermal or A4 — try both) and look for the UPI QR code on the printed preview if you've set up a UPI ID. Look for the WhatsApp and Email icons next to Print too — they save the invoice as a PDF, open the folder so you can attach it, then open WhatsApp or your email app pre-filled and ready to send. Nothing here is saved once you exit the tutorial.
universal.customersBody: Every customer you've ever billed lives here, with their full purchase and payment history.
universal.productsBody: Add and manage everything you sell here — pricing, tax rate, and stock all live on one screen. Set a valuation method (Weighted Average, FIFO, or Standard Cost) and turn a product into a Kit made of other products, right from the same form.
universal.inventoryBody: Track stock levels and see every stock movement — sales, purchases, and manual adjustments — in one place. When stock falls below its reorder level, generate a draft Purchase Order straight from here.
universal.reportsBody: Sales, Inventory, Outstanding, Profit & Loss, GST/HSN summaries, and more — all generated instantly from your real data. Click through a few different report tiles to see how each one looks.
universal.settingsBody: Everything about how Sarang is configured lives here: your Business Profile, Tax setup, Users & Roles, Language, which optional modules are turned on for your business, your Invoice Templates, your Backup location, and your License. Worth a full look around at least once.
universal.backupBody: Your data lives only on this device — this screen is how you protect it. Set up automatic backups here so you're never caught out.
universal.licenseBody: Sarang is free for your first 12 months. This screen always shows exactly where you stand, and is where you'll renew when the time comes.

restaurantTables.title: Tables
restaurantTables.body: See every table at a glance — open, occupied, or reserved. Tap a table to start an order, or merge two tables for a bigger group. If you turn on QR Table Ordering above, save your WiFi network once and every table's QR code prints as a WiFi-join code plus the order code together, so a customer can join your network and start ordering in two scans. Try it: open a table and see it turn occupied instantly.

restaurantKot.title: Kitchen Order Tickets (KOT)
restaurantKot.body: Send an order straight to the kitchen with one tap. Try sending one — it'll appear immediately on the Kitchen Display Board, exactly like a real ticket a cook would see.

restaurantRecipes.title: Recipes
restaurantRecipes.body: Link a dish to the raw ingredients it uses, so every sale can automatically deduct stock. Set one up and see how it connects a menu item to your inventory.

retailReturns.title: Returns
retailReturns.body: Process a customer return against a real past invoice — pick the invoice, choose what's being returned, and see the refund and stock adjustment happen automatically.

distributorBulkOrder.title: Bulk Order
distributorBulkOrder.body: Build a large, multi-item order fast for a wholesale customer — add several products at once instead of one at a time, exactly how a real distributor order works.

distributorOutstanding.title: Outstanding Analytics
distributorOutstanding.body: See which customers owe you the most and for how long, at a glance — this is how you'd spot who to follow up with first.

distributorFieldOrders.title: Field Orders
distributorFieldOrders.body: This is where orders captured by your field reps out on the road land, ready for you to review and approve.

distributorPricing.title: Customer Pricing
distributorPricing.body: Set different prices per customer class — your best wholesale accounts don't have to pay the same rate as a walk-in.

agriDashboard.title: Agri Inputs Dashboard
agriDashboard.body: One combined view of both consumables (seeds, fertilizer) and equipment (tools, machinery) — everything an agri-inputs business stocks, in one place.

batchTracking.title: Batch & Expiry Tracking
batchTracking.body: Every batch of stock is tracked with its own expiry date — try adding one and see how it flags when something's nearing expiry.

serialTracking.title: Serial & Warranty Tracking
serialTracking.body: Track individual units by serial number (and IMEI, if enabled) so you always know exactly which unit you sold to which customer, and when its warranty ends.

repairTickets.title: Repair Tickets
repairTickets.body: Log a device in for repair, track its status, and hand it back — a full repair/RMA workflow from intake to return.

rawMaterials.title: Raw Materials
rawMaterials.body: Track the ingredients or components you buy in, before they become a finished product.

billOfMaterials.title: Bill of Materials (BOM)
billOfMaterials.body: Define exactly which raw materials go into one finished product — set one up and see how it becomes the recipe production runs from.

productionOrders.title: Production Orders
productionOrders.body: Start a production run against a BOM — try creating one and watch it consume raw materials and produce finished stock.

finishedGoods.title: Finished Goods
finishedGoods.body: Everything your production line has completed lands here, ready to sell.

dispatchTracking.title: Dispatch Tracking
dispatchTracking.body: Track a shipment from your warehouse to its recipient, start to finish.

vendorManagement.title: Vendors
vendorManagement.body: Manage the suppliers your production line depends on for raw materials.

productionAnalytics.title: Production Analytics
productionAnalytics.body: See throughput, output, and efficiency across every production run at a glance.

logisticsFleet.title: Fleet
logisticsFleet.body: Manage the vehicles you use to move goods — try adding one and see it become available for assigning to a shipment.

logisticsCarriers.title: Carriers
logisticsCarriers.body: Manage third-party carriers you use alongside (or instead of) your own fleet.

logisticsShipments.title: Shipments
logisticsShipments.body: Track a shipment end-to-end — create one and follow it from pickup to delivery.

logisticsGrn.title: Goods Receipt Notes (GRN)
logisticsGrn.body: Record what actually arrived against a purchase order — try creating one and see how it reconciles against what was ordered.

logisticsChallan.title: Delivery Challan
logisticsChallan.body: Generate a delivery challan — the document that travels with goods in transit, separate from the invoice.

logisticsFreight.title: Freight Ledger
logisticsFreight.body: Track what you're paying carriers for freight, all in one ledger.

logisticsAnalytics.title: Logistics Analytics
logisticsAnalytics.body: See delivery performance and freight costs across your whole logistics operation at a glance.

printLabels.title: Barcode & Label Printing
printLabels.body: Generate and print barcode labels for your products — try picking a product and printing a label, exactly as you would for real shelf stock.

serviceProjects.title: Projects
serviceProjects.body: Track a client project from kickoff to completion, with its own tasks and milestones.

serviceTickets.title: Service Tickets
serviceTickets.body: Log a customer service request and track it through to resolution.

serviceJobCards.title: Job Cards
serviceJobCards.body: Create a job card for a specific piece of work — try one and see how it tracks the job from start to finish.

workTracking.title: Work Tracking
workTracking.body: See time and effort logged against jobs or projects, all in one place.

customerHistory.title: Customer History
customerHistory.body: See a customer's full service history in one place — every job, ticket, and visit they've ever had with you.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.body: Book a real appointment — pick a customer, a time slot, and a service. This is the heart of how a service business runs its day.

serviceCatalog.title: Service Catalog
serviceCatalog.body: Define the services you offer and their prices — this is what populates the choices when booking an appointment.

normalRanges.title: Normal Ranges
normalRanges.body: Set the reference ranges clinical notes compare a patient's readings against (e.g. normal blood pressure range).

providerSchedule.title: Provider Schedule
providerSchedule.body: Set your (or your staff's) working hours and availability — this controls which time slots show up when booking an appointment.

whatsappReminders.title: WhatsApp Reminders
whatsappReminders.body: See the queue of appointment reminders scheduled to go out automatically to your customers.

vetPatients.title: Patients (Pets)
vetPatients.body: Every pet you've ever treated, with its own profile and visit history — try registering one.

tokenQueue.title: Token Queue
tokenQueue.body: Manage a walk-in queue with numbered tokens — try issuing one and see it move through the queue.

clinicalNotes.title: Clinical Notes
clinicalNotes.body: Record a patient's visit notes — symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment — all tied to their appointment.

labOrders.title: Lab Test Orders
labOrders.body: Create a test order for a patient, then record the result once it's ready — a full order-to-result workflow.

bloodDonors.title: Donors
bloodDonors.body: Every registered blood donor, with their donation history — try registering one.

bloodDonations.title: Donations & Screening
bloodDonations.body: Record a donation and its screening result — try one and see how it becomes available blood stock only after passing screening.

bloodStock.title: Blood Stock
bloodStock.body: See exactly how many units of each blood type and group you have on hand, ready to issue.

bloodIssue.title: Blood Issue
bloodIssue.body: Issue blood units to a patient or hospital — try one and watch the stock count update immediately.

rentalBookings.title: Rental Bookings
rentalBookings.body: Book an item out to a customer for a period, then check it back in — a full checkout-and-return cycle.

rentalUnits.title: Rental Units
rentalUnits.body: Every item you have available to rent out, and whether it's currently checked out.

hotelBookings.title: Hotel Bookings
hotelBookings.body: Book a guest into a room — try one and see it turn the room's status to occupied.

hotelRooms.title: Rooms
hotelRooms.body: See every room's status at a glance — available, occupied, or being cleaned.

hotelHousekeeping.title: Housekeeping
hotelHousekeeping.body: Track which rooms need cleaning and mark them ready once done — try updating one and see the room's status change.

metalRates.title: Metal Rates
metalRates.body: Set today's gold/silver rate — this is what a jewellery sale's price is actually calculated from, not a fixed selling price.

metalExchange.title: Old-Metal Exchange
metalExchange.body: Record a customer trading in old jewellery against a new purchase, valued at today's metal rate.

dentalRecall.title: Recall Schedule
dentalRecall.body: See which patients are due for a follow-up visit, so none are missed.

sessionPacks.title: Session Packs
sessionPacks.body: Sell a bundle of sessions upfront (e.g. 10 physio sessions), then track how many a patient has used.

staffCommission.title: Staff Commission
staffCommission.body: See commission earned per staff member based on the sales or services they've handled.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.body: Sell and track gym memberships — try creating one and see its start and expiry dates.

groupClasses.title: Group Classes
groupClasses.body: Schedule a class with a capacity limit, then enroll members into it.

learners.title: Learners
learners.body: Every driving-school learner's profile, with their progress toward a license.

driveSessions.title: Drive Sessions
driveSessions.body: Schedule and log an individual driving lesson against a learner's profile.

legalCases.title: Cases
legalCases.body: Track a legal case from filing to resolution, with its own hearings and documents.

compliance.title: Compliance Tasks
compliance.body: Track recurring compliance deadlines (filings, renewals) so nothing is missed.

engagements.title: Engagements
engagements.body: Track a client engagement — the scope of work you've agreed to do for them.

rocFilings.title: ROC Filings
rocFilings.body: Track company-secretary filings with the Registrar of Companies and their due dates.

timeTracking.title: Time Tracking
timeTracking.body: Log billable hours against a client or engagement — try logging an entry and see it ready to bill.

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: Track a prospective client from first contact through to becoming a real, billing customer.

consultingProjects.title: Projects
consultingProjects.body: Track a client project with its own milestones and deliverables.

retainers.title: Retainers
retainers.body: Track an ongoing retainer agreement — hours or value used against what a client has paid for upfront.

issues.title: Issues
issues.body: Log and track an issue raised during a project through to resolution.

drawingRegister.title: Drawing Register
drawingRegister.body: Track every drawing revision for a project, so everyone always knows which version is current.

siteVisits.title: Site Visit Log
siteVisits.body: Log a site visit with notes and photos — try one and see how it builds a real visit history for a project.

students.title: Students
students.body: Every enrolled student's profile, with their batch, fees, and performance in one place.

coachingBatches.title: Batches
coachingBatches.body: Group students into a batch (a class/section) with its own schedule.

coachingAttendance.title: Attendance
coachingAttendance.body: Mark attendance for a batch, session by session.

feeCollection.title: Fee Collection
feeCollection.body: Record a student's fee payment and see their outstanding balance update.

performances.title: Performances
performances.body: Track how each student is performing across tests and assessments over time.

testScores.title: Test Scores
testScores.body: Record a student's score for a specific test.

shootBookings.title: Shoot Bookings
shootBookings.body: Book a photography shoot with a client — try one and see it become a schedulable event.

events.title: Events
events.body: Manage an event from booking through to its run-of-show on the day.

properties.title: Properties
properties.body: Every property you're selling or renting out, with its own listing details and status.

carServiceJobs.title: Job Cards
carServiceJobs.body: Open a job card for a vehicle being serviced, and track the work done against it.

tailoring.title: Tailoring Orders
tailoring.body: Take a tailoring order with a customer's measurements, and track it through to delivery.

pestControl.title: Pest Control Contracts
pestControl.body: Track a recurring pest-control contract and its scheduled visits.

placement.title: Placement
placement.body: Track a candidate through a job placement, from application to a confirmed hire.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.body: Send a customer a quote before they commit — try creating one, then convert it to a real invoice with one click once they say yes.

creditNotes.title: Credit Notes
creditNotes.body: Issue a credit note against a past invoice — for a discount, a billing correction, or goods returned. It adjusts what the customer owes without touching the original invoice.

debitNotes.title: Debit Notes
debitNotes.body: Record a debit note against a supplier — for a purchase price correction or something you're charging back to them.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders
purchaseOrders.body: Create a purchase order to a supplier, then receive the goods against it when they arrive — keeps what you ordered and what actually showed up cleanly separate.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.body: Every supplier you buy from, with their own purchase and payment history — the other side of the business from Customers.

bills.title: Bills
bills.body: Record what a supplier actually billed you — a purchase, a rent bill, professional fees, anything you owe — with or without a Purchase Order behind it. This is what makes your Purchase Register and payables aging correct.

supplierPayments.title: Payments Made
supplierPayments.body: Every payment you've made to a supplier against a Bill, in one place — with reversal support if one was entered wrong.

bankReconciliation.title: Bank Accounts
bankReconciliation.body: Add a real bank or cash account, then open it to import a statement and auto-match it against what Sarang already recorded — try it and see how it flags what still needs your review instead of guessing.

manualJournal.title: Journal Entries
manualJournal.body: Every Invoice, Bill, and Payment already posts here automatically — this is where you post a correction by hand when you need to. Sarang rejects it outright if your debits and credits don't match exactly.

cashClose.title: Cash Close
cashClose.body: Reconcile the cash in your drawer against what Sarang recorded for the day — try it and see how it flags a shortage or overage instantly instead of at month-end.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.body: Log a business expense — rent, utilities, anything that isn't stock — to keep your real profit picture accurate.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Attach and store documents against records across Sarang — receipts, contracts, ID proofs — so nothing lives only on paper.

importData.title: Import Data
importData.body: Bring in existing data in bulk — like a spreadsheet of products or customers — instead of typing everything in one at a time.

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.body: Every significant action anyone takes in Sarang is recorded here, tamper-evident — who did what, and when.

hrEmployees.title: Employees
hrEmployees.body: Add your staff here — this is also where their login accounts and roles get set up.

hrAttendance.title: Attendance
hrAttendance.body: Mark daily attendance for your staff — present, absent, or on leave.

hrLeave.title: Leave
hrLeave.body: Track and approve leave requests from your staff.

hrPayroll.title: Payroll
hrPayroll.body: Run payroll for your staff based on their attendance and salary structure.

salesOrders.title: Sales Orders
salesOrders.body: Commit to a sale before you're ready to invoice — try creating one, confirm it, then bill it fully or in parts as goods ship or work gets done.

priceLists.title: Price Lists
priceLists.body: Set quantity-based pricing for a customer or supplier — buy 50+ units and pay less per unit. Assign a price list to a customer and Sarang applies it automatically at billing.

pricingSchemes.title: Pricing Schemes
pricingSchemes.body: Set up a Buy-X-Get-Y-Free or volume-discount offer — try one and watch it suggest itself automatically in the cart the moment a qualifying item is added.

recurringProfiles.title: Recurring Profiles
recurringProfiles.body: Set up an invoice, bill, or expense to repeat on a schedule — weekly, monthly, or yearly — so you never have to recreate the same document by hand again.

approvalWorkflows.title: Approval Workflows
approvalWorkflows.body: Require sign-off before a large sales or purchase order is confirmed — set a threshold and an approver, and Sarang holds any order over that amount for approval instead of confirming it immediately.

locations.title: Locations
locations.body: If you store stock in more than one place, add a second location here and try a Transfer Stock — everything still starts in one default location until you actually add another.

costCentres.title: Cost Centres
costCentres.body: Create a cost centre for a department, branch, or project, then pick it on your next invoice, bill, or expense — see the profit and spend it drove on the Cost Centre P&L report.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.body: Set a monthly budget for a cost centre, a specific account, or the whole company, then check back after the month to see how real spend compared.
